name: beam
tagline_zh: 本地代码会话一键脱敏发布，生成只读链接。别人看到你的调试过程，却看不到密钥和路径。
tagline_en: Publish a redacted local coding session as a read-only Beam link. Share the journey, hide the secrets.
desc_en: Publish a redacted local coding session to an authenticated read-only Beam catalog.
why_zh: 同类工具只分享结果，它分享过程且自动脱敏，让协作复盘像看回放一样安全直观。
why_en: Unlike result-only tools, it shares the full session with automatic redaction—safe, replayable, and honest.
